issues.issue: This line is about 31.7% of governmental receipts, over the 10% threshold for 'other'. It is a one-off spike: 241.98 in 2023-24 and 280.00 budgeted for 2025-26. The form gives no breakdown, so 'other' is defensible, but it could be loan proceeds, a grant, insurance proceeds or an asset sale.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 22,217.54 (col 2); line 24 Debt Service: Payments to Bank Loans (Fire Districts) 7,000.00 newly budgeted for 2025-26 (col 3)
issues.issue: A person needs to decide whether this 22,217.54 is bank loan proceeds (debt_proceeds) rather than revenue. The 2025-26 budget adds a new bank-loan repayment line, so a loan may have been taken out in 2024-25 and booked as local receipts. The extraction has no decision_needed entry for this.
